doc.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Sherwood, big bands and sound concept
title: Charles Mingus and the Debut label
summary: Rudy recorded Mingus in the Lennie Tristano days and remembers Mingus's wife.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution

blocks.x: Did you record Charlie Mingus, too?
Sure. That was back in the days where Lennie Tristano was around. They were friends.
And he had his own record label?
Debut, right. I knew Cecilia, too, his wife at the time. She was a very nice lady, or still is, I hope.
